snippet.title: Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition reveal trailer - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
Take an exclusive look at Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition, unveiled at the PC Gaming Show 2025

Aspyr will be bringing the award-winning  Neverwinter Nights 2 back to PC and on to modern consoles for the first time. This  definitive version of the game will feature full controller support, all three expansions,  Steam Workshop modding, a variety of gameplay enhancements, improved textures,  and more. 

Dungeons & Dragons Neverwinter Nights 2: Enhanced Edition Includes all expansions:  Mask of the Betrayer, Storm of Zehir and Mysteries of Westgate.

Wishlist now, and prepare for your return to Neverwinter:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2738630/Dungeons__Dragons_Neverwinter_Nights_2_Enhanced_Edition?snr=1_614_615_pcgamingshow2025_100703
